{{Quote|Sar Omant. Actually, that's Colonel Sar Omant, of the Freelance Mercenary Corps. At your service - unfortunately.|Sar Omant, to Jos Vondar|<ref name="Intermezzo" />}}
The '''Freelance Mercenary Corps''' were a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit that joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle of Drongar]]. It was led by a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sar Omant]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the unit.<ref name="Intermezzo" />
